title: 第1章 师傅你看胸
slug: 桃运大相师全本免费-桃运大相师最新章节列表
content_zh:
烈烈夏日的树荫里，一个十八九岁的少年悠闲的躺在一张简单的吊绳床上，手里拿着一本厚厚的《柳庄相法》，嘴里念念有词，仔细看，这本书里竟然别有洞天，夹了一本画满大胸妹子的地摊杂志。
这少年名为展步，此时，他正看的津津有味，很惬意，不知道的还以为他在研究相法。
这是一个坐落在小山上的幽静小院落，树荫浓密，鸣蝉阵阵，外面溪水叮咚，一副世外桃源的景致。
此时，一个硬朗的声音在大堂传了出来：“展步，去开门，有生意上门。”
吊绳床上的展步一个轱辘站了起来，贼兮兮的看了大堂一眼，发现没有人发现自己的“小秘密”，这才把书仔细合上，不露痕迹，然后起身去开门。
说话的人是展步的师傅，当地很出名的一个算命老道，师傅既然说有生意上门，那就绝对错不了，展步对师傅的本事非常相信。
果然，展步一开门就发现门口停了一辆黑色轿车，一个浓妆艳抹的女人正朝着门口走来。
展步知道，这是来找师傅算命的，师徒俩虽然一直生活在山上，但是老道算命算了几十年，颇有名声，只是这十多年发生了一些事情，老道才动了归隐的念头，住到了山上。
能够打听到这里来的，都是非富即贵，一般人打听不到。
“这里可是柳大师的宅院？”那女人问展步道。
展步的眼睛隐秘的扫了一眼女人的胸脯，然后淡淡的说道：“是的，师傅算到你要来，早就在等你了。”
这女人听到展步的话撇了撇嘴，显然不相信展步说什么算到她要来之类的话，在女人的心中，有些相师的确很神，但是应该还没神到这个地步。
不过她也没说什么，这次是求人算命，她也不能表现的太过不敬。
大堂中，老道仙风道骨，目光精湛，走到了这女人的对面，一脸惊讶：“恭喜夫人，恭喜夫人啊，夫人这面色红润，颜如凝霞，这是喜兆啊，老道先行给夫人道喜了，想必这几日之内，夫人的丈夫应该就要高升……”
老道的话还没有说完，这女人的表情就凝固在脸上，紧接着面色冷了下来，如果不是老道的唾沫星子不断，只怕这女人早就发作了。
“咳……咳……”展步对着老道挤眉弄眼，低声悄悄说道：“师傅，你看胸，你看胸啊，你的面相看的不对……”
看到这女人的脸色，再听到徒弟的话，老道不由得心中一紧，难道自己又看走眼了？这女人明明面相里全是喜色，并且有旺夫的势头，难道不是她丈夫要升官或发财？
一想到这里，老道不由得生气，老道为什么归隐山林？不是自命清高，实在是这几年算命这行当越发不好做了，人都说越老越精，老道在算命这一途上却越老越偏，越来越不准。
记得几十年前，老道凭借一身风水相术就博得了一个柳神仙的名号，只是后来化妆品大量涌现，化妆术日新月异，这尼玛可苦了相师。
本来月牙似的眼睛，随意打扮一下，眼睛就能跟核桃似的，一头霸王龙，一个眼神就能把人吓死，可是随便一打扮，硬生生能化身小白兔，小鸟依人……

终于，老道接连几次碰壁，被送了一个老骗子的名号之后，一怒之下带着徒弟们隐居了起来，实在是，不堪忍辱……
可身边这徒弟却独辟蹊径，自创了一个什么相胸术，倒是能屡屡看准女人的运势与未来，这让老道觉得脸红又羞愧。
脸红的是，自己的相面术屡屡碰壁，总是跑偏，隐隐有被徒弟超越的迹象。
羞愧的是，这相胸术怎么听都像是旁门左道，提不上台面，这要是被人知道自己教了这样一个徒弟，说出去还不被同行笑死，实在是愧对师门，愧对祖宗……
为了这事，老道是劝过训过打过骂过，可是这小子生性皮赖，什么招都没用，一副一条道走到黑的架势，为了这事，老道不止动了一次把展步赶下山的念头。
其实老道也知道展步的相胸术是怎么来的，这东西虽然荒诞不经，但是也有根有源，他是把自己教他的风水学，龙脉堪舆之类的东西融合在人体上，观察人体起伏变化总结的学问，也确实有点灵验，但是老道就是不想展步钻研这个。

content_en:
In the shade of the trees in the scorching summer, an eighteen or nineteen-year-old boy was lying leisurely on a simple hammock bed, holding a thick copy of "Liu Zhuang Xiangfa" in his hand, muttering something to himself. If he looked carefully, he found that there was something special in this book, and there was a street magazine full of pictures of big-breasted girls.
This young man's name is Zhan Bu. At this time, he is watching with great interest and contentment. Those who don't know think he is studying physiognomy.
This is a quiet little courtyard located on a hill, with dense shade, chirping cicadas, and the tinkling stream outside, giving it a picture of a paradise.
At this time, a strong voice came out in the lobby: "Zhan step, open the door, there is business coming."
Zhan Bu, who was on the sling bed, stood up and took a sly glance at the lobby. He found that no one had discovered his "little secret", so he carefully closed the book without leaving any traces, and then stood up to open the door.
The person who spoke was Zhan Bu's master, a well-known fortune teller in the local area. Since the master said there was business coming to his door, he couldn't be wrong. Zhan Bu believed in the master's ability very much.
Sure enough, as soon as Zhan Bu opened the door, he found a black car parked at the door and a woman with heavy makeup walking towards the door.
Zhan Bu knew that he came to see his master for fortune-telling. Although the master and his disciples had been living in the mountains, the old Taoist had been telling fortunes for decades and was quite famous. However, something happened in the past ten years or so, and the old Taoist thought of going into seclusion and living in the mountains.
Those who can inquire about this place are either rich or noble, and ordinary people cannot inquire about it.
"Is this Master Liu's residence?" the woman asked Zhan Xingluo.
Zhan Bu's eyes glanced at the woman's breasts secretly, and then said lightly: "Yes, the master has been waiting for you since he expected you to come."
The woman curled her lips when she heard Zhan Bu's words. She obviously didn't believe what Zhan Bu said about her coming. In the woman's heart, some fortune tellers were indeed very good, but they probably weren't that good yet.
But she didn't say anything. This time she was asking for fortune telling, and she couldn't be too disrespectful.
In the lobby, the old Taoist with a fairy-like demeanor and sharp eyes walked to the opposite side of the woman with a surprised look on his face: "Congratulations, madam. Congratulations, madam. Madam's face is rosy and her face is like a rosy cloud. This is a good sign. The old Taoist went ahead to say congratulations to madam. I believe that within a few days, madam's husband will be promoted..."
Before the old Taoist finished speaking, the woman's expression froze on her face, and then her face turned cold. If it weren't for the constant spitting of the old Taoist, I'm afraid this woman would have had an attack.
"Cough...cough..." Zhan Bu winked at the old Taoist and whispered in a low voice: "Master, look at your chest, look at your chest, your face is wrong..."
Seeing the woman's face and hearing the disciple's words, the old Taoist couldn't help but feel nervous. Could it be that he had made a mistake again? This woman's face is obviously full of joy, and she has the potential to prosper her husband. Could it be that her husband wants to be promoted or make a fortune?
Thinking of this, the old Taoist couldn't help but get angry. Why did the old Taoist retreat to the mountains and forests? I’m not claiming to be lofty, but the fortune-telling business has become increasingly difficult in recent years. People say that the older you get, the better you get. However, experienced fortune tellers are becoming more biased and inaccurate as they get older.
I remember that a few decades ago, the old Taoist won the name of a willow fairy by virtue of his Feng Shui physiognomy. However, later on, cosmetics appeared in large quantities and makeup techniques were changing with each passing day. This was a real pain for physiognomists.
Originally, the crescent-like eyes can look like walnuts if you dress them up casually. A Tyrannosaurus Rex can scare people to death with just one look. But if you dress up casually, you can suddenly transform into a little white rabbit, a bird that clings to you...
Finally, after hitting the wall several times and being called an old liar, the old Taoist led his disciples to live in seclusion in anger. He really couldn't bear the humiliation...
But the apprentice next to him found a new way and created some kind of chest-viewing technique of his own, which was able toHe always looks at a woman's fortune and future, which makes the old man feel blushing and ashamed.
What makes me blush is that my fortune-telling skills have repeatedly hit the wall, always going astray, and there are faint signs of being surpassed by my disciples.
What is shameful is that this chest physiognomy sounds like heresy and cannot be brought to the forefront. If people know that I have taught such a disciple, and if I tell it and my colleagues are not laughing to death, I am really ashamed of my master and my ancestors...
For this matter, the old Taoist had tried to persuade, discipline, and beat him up, but this kid was a scumbag by nature, and all his tricks were of no use. He looked like he was going all the way to the end. For this matter, the old Taoist thought of driving Zhan Bu down the mountain more than once.
In fact, the old Taoist also knows how Zhan Bu's chest-building technique came about. Although this thing is absurd, it has its roots. He integrated the Feng Shui and Dragon Vein Kanyu he taught him into the human body. The knowledge of observing the ups and downs of the human body and summarizing it is indeed somewhat effective, but the old Taoist just doesn't want Zhan Bu to delve into this.
